risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~24% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.353), which favours a weighted combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.9096 and seasonal strength 0.0344; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.353); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.834.
